## _「感謝你的魚！」_ ![Minecraft 標誌風格，頂部顯示 CREATE，底部顯示 WORLD OF COLOR，接著是 FTM 和 FEED THE MACHINE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a16411d5992b272d93a984cdde27c358b2aa001c.png) # ![一些微小的物品紋理](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b97d1e401b948e75cdd26f84e30363421c655b1d.png) **[CWOC](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/create-world-of-color) - Feed The Machine** ![更多微小的物品紋理](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64b8743b9c660938d0ea0ca7bd2fbec0318b2b17.png) ...是一款旨在模擬 [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) 眾多擴充模組在 Minecraft **程式設計師風格** 下會呈現何種樣貌的資源包！

[![顯示「回報問題」文字的按鈕](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4810204932f5155b4cb528e3f384c3727e7b6170.png)](https://github.com/soapinamicrowave/cwoc-ftm/issues) [![顯示「圖庫圖片」文字的按鈕](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56e08febc882d3ce054ad32238f9e997d95de29a.png)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cwoc-ftm/gallery) [![顯示「檢視原始碼」文字的按鈕](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/165bb894282cb777e4127ebfffe7be8a34e0251f.png)](https://github.com/soapinamicrowave/cwoc-ftm) ## 支援的擴充模組 標有紅圈的擴充模組表示其紋理由 [Flabberghastio](https://modrinth.com/user/flabberghastio) 製作！ [![顯示「Aeronautics」的橫幅/按鈕](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88da36d43656132c179dfffba6c746911a592e28.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics) [![顯示「Hypertubes」的橫幅/按鈕](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de6b8ce725228a3039de68687fc76f44fd7ea832.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/hypertube) [![顯示「Bits 'n' Bobs」的橫幅/按鈕](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae7b1e90f3da2226a484ebd5747630c7fca27642.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-bits-n-bobs) [![顯示「Melodies & Mechanisms」的橫幅/按鈕](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e79961468125bc4bb173743dc5ab5e2229523cd1.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-melodies-mechanisms) [![顯示「Totem Factory」的橫幅/按鈕](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3dce7e7ecd70729cef59f2a4eba1e0081e45a245.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-totem-factory) ## 推薦 [![顯示 PACP 的 pack.png 的按鈕](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/412fa3790da06dd8525167ddd334ec090b7d4db4.png)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pacp)
一如往常，請將 [程式設計師風格延續計畫](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pacp) 加在此資源包與 CWOC 之下，但在一般 **程式設計師風格** 之上，以獲得最佳體驗。
（本資源包中的許多調色盤或紋理都直接參考了 PACP 以保持一致性！）
